_note: The shape of the operator's targets.json for handoff.mjs --pass targeted --targets <file> (owner 2026-09-30, H8; the axes re-cut 2026-10-01, Q10 of the v0.7 questionnaire). One entry per skeleton file, one per field path: axis is one of tension, cost, vocabulary, four-question (a fifth is not added without a ruling), beat is the operator's one sentence on what the current line fails on that axis, written from the read. The beat never quotes the line: the current sentence is withheld, and the reuse check blocks a four-word run of it. The cases below are the 2026-09-29 north star's own.

ledger[2].beat: the cost to others must be the reader's own act and what it takes from the people in the General's domain; the current line hands the cost to a chorus and opens on what people can do

function.advise_catalyst.beat: the advice must answer what to do on this chart's band with the remedy verb the spec names; the current line is generic across bands

ledger[1].beat: the passage must name the Artisan's either-or on Water (feeding others or feeding the feeling of being needed) in the reader's second person; the current line stages a kitchen and names no tension

gifts[6].beat: the desc must name the drive and its cost in plain psychological words at B1 to B2 and never open on a capacity; the current desc opens on what you can do and names no cost
